mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_error_book (stu_id, hq_id, c_id, wrong_answer, correct_answer, analysis, tag, error_count, is_mastered, last_wrong_time) VALUES (#{stuId}, #{qId}, #{cId}, #{wrongAnswer}, #{correctAnswer}, '来自作业批改的错题，请复习巩固', #{tag}, 1, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE my_error_book SET error_count = error_count + 1, wrong_answer = #{wrongAnswer}, is_mastered = 0, last_wrong_time = NOW() WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} AND hq_id = #{qId}
